thread:
maya: heads up — onboarding APAC gpu pool is failing, nodes keep erroring during keystore handshake. KMS decryption errors in kubelet logs and a ton of natgw bytes showing up in billing dashboard. anyone seen similar?
kevin: saw this on staging yesterday after the audit sampling change. SNI inspection at the edge started dropping some privnet traffic to keystore proxy. conntrack counters exploded.
jordan: can you paste the kubelet log snippet?
maya: paste: 
```
E0323 09:12:03 kubelet.go:234] keystore decrypt failed: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection reset by peer
... TLS handshake error: remote error: tls: bad certificate
```
lia: ops-bot just alerted high conntrack on privnet-ngw-2: 84k -> 620k in 20m. that causes NAT port exhaustion and extra NATGW scaling = $$$. :grimacing:
ops-bot: ALERT: conntrack_count(privnet-ngw-2) > 500k, natgw-surge triggered, estimated extra cost $120/hr.
kevin: probable root: new fw rule applied yesterday that enables deep-sni/proxy for outbound. it breaks quick TLS re-use to keystore proxy so connections get torn and retried. we also changed audit sampling to pipeline more logs -> more outbound connections to SIEM. combined effect.
jordan: can we confirm whether traffic to keystore is going via NATGW or privatelink? a privatelink would avoid natgw egress.
maya: current route: in apac we don't yet have privatelink for keystore, so it's NATGW. moving to privatelink needs infra and ent-approval (IAM boundary tweaks). short term we need to stop the SNI inspection rule or whitelabel keystore host.
lia: security-bot flagged that whitelisting keystore host needs a JIRA and compliance signoff for audit retention.
security-bot: note: APAC regs require retained audit logs for 2 years; any bypass of egress inspection must record justification and a compensating control.
kevin: short mitigation proposal: add a targeted egress SG rule allowing 443 to keystore-proxy.internal.apac (10.240.5.12) from kubelet subnets, plus temporarily disable deep-sni on that host. flip today during low traffic window.
jordan: +1. also add conntrack tuning: sysctl net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=800000 on the NAT instances as short term.
maya: i can push the SG change and conntrack tweak. command i'll run: 
```
# add sg rule
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-0abc --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 10.240.0.0/18 --description "temp: keystore egress allow"
# conntrack
sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=800000
```
lia: please record the justification and set a 6h TTL on the SG rule. we need to be able to show change history.
kevin: i'll coordinate rollback once privatelink is ready. we should also throttle audit exporter to reduce fanout: set exporter.batch_size=50 and exporter.max_concurrency=4.
maya: putting short postmortem in #incidents after mitigation. who can own follow-up to implement privatelink?
jordan: i'll own privatelink task. will create ticket and estimate 3 days (infra + security review).
security-bot: reminder: when creating the ticket include a schema of how audit logs are ingested and where keys are stored. add KMS key policy snippet.
kevin: also verify IAM role boundary — i saw node profile rejected assume role earlier. adding link to log: https://console.internal/logs/abc123 (private)
maya: ok pushing SG + conntrack now, will update in 10m.
ops-bot: NOTE: deployment window scheduled 10:40z -> 11:10z for apac mitigation.
maya: mitigation applied. conntrack down to 72k and node join rate improved. one node still in crashloop with handshake timeout, digging.
jordan: great job. please add cost estimate to the ticket: extra natgw usage last 24h = $2.3k.
lia: filing compliance note and tagging security owner @lia.
maya: final: we keep the temp SG for 6h, throttle audit exporter, spin up privatelink ticket, and follow up with a postmortem. :thumbsup:
kevin: adding runbook snippet to ticket for future: 
```
if keystore handshake errors:
  - check fw deep-sni rules
  - verify route to keystore (privatelink vs natgw)
  - check conntrack and increase nf_conntrack_max if needed
  - throttle audit exporter to reduce fanout
  - create temp SG allow and set TTL
```
jordan: leaving a :eyes: reaction. closing thread in 6h unless new errors.
